component.name: Inara
component.summary: Use a phone or tablet as a multitouch trackpad and graphics tablet for a Linux PC

description.p: Inara turns a mobile device into a multitouch trackpad/remote input device for a Linux desktop PC. It serves a single-page web app over HTTPS that the phone connects to with WebRTC, streaming pointer events to a virtual trackpad or graphics tablet and the live desktop back to the phone.
